words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّةُ}} ({{tr:jannatu}}) is the delayed subject disclosed after {{ar:عِندَهَا}} ({{tr:ʿindahā}}), so the reader first receives a coordinate and then the entity stationed there. As construct head, it is not simply "a garden" with an added description; its bond with {{ar:ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:al-maʾwā}}) makes the title mean a garden defined by shelter. The root's covering field remains positively active at the level of image: the selected sense is the afterlife garden, while the enclosure sense explains why shelter is the natural function of this garden. The standard nominal reading holds that concealment inside a place, whereas the reported verbal reparse would make concealment an event; that contrast highlights the received clause's still, locative architecture. Its singular construct form and unique compound specialize familiar garden language by refuge rather than by bliss, perpetuity, or flowing rivers, with the same-surah garden recurrence at 53:32 adding a local thread. Even the close recitational joining into the shelter noun reinforces that the phrase is one bound title rather than two separable images.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:al-maʾwā}}) completes the delayed subject; the sentence does not fully name its subject until this final genitive noun closes the construct after {{ar:جَنَّةُ}} ({{tr:jannatu}}). Its case keeps it from becoming a separate location: it defines the garden's function as the known shelter. The place-noun form makes refuge locatable, and the root field of seeking, lodging, and giving shelter lets the final word feel like homing and settled rest, not mere residence. Because the same endpoint vocabulary can mark both blessed and punished destinations, the garden frame here reclaims the endpoint as refuge; that contrast is visible against punishment contexts such as 79:39 and blessed destination language such as 79:41. The ayah therefore moves from the coordinate in {{ar:عِندَهَا}} ({{tr:ʿindahā}}), through an enclosed garden, to the final word "shelter"; enclosure and shelter cooperate, with the garden supplying the containing realm and the final noun naming what that containment accomplishes. Its long-a closure and echo with the boundary title in 53:14 bind limit and refuge: motion reaches the limit, then settles at the shelter beside it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full construction عندها جنة المأوى joins locative presence, an enclosed garden, and a place that gathers arrivals.
baseline_models.mechanism: Proximity fixes an enclosure at the deictic site, while مأوى makes that enclosure functional: it draws the arriving subject into shelter rather than merely decorating the location.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and presence make عندها the locative hinge attaching the refuge to the indicated site.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جنة and مأوى allow the garden's enclosure and the refuge's gathering action to be read together.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden protects by covering from perception and by forming a shielded interior; refuge is therefore produced through concealment, not only through pleasant abundance.

activation_trace.role: Immediate presence makes concealment coexist with nearness rather than remoteness.

changed_reading.before: The garden is an exposed reward-space identifiable by its scenery.
changed_reading.after: The garden is a near but covered sanctuary whose concealment is part of how it protects.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جنة can activate vigorous growth and fresh beginning, while مأوى can activate compassionate turning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dense new growth is held inside a compassionate shelter, yielding a nursery-like model in which refuge restores and begins life rather than merely storing occupants.

changed_reading.before: Refuge means a static destination after danger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening fall, later approach and suspension from above, and a single renewed descent form a controlled trajectory. مأوى then reads as the receiving point into which that trajectory resolves.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, approach, suspension, and shelter; I supply the arrow that the shelter receives and resolves that trajectory. A live alternative is that the motions describe only the encounter while the garden remains an adjacent landmark.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a static object beside the encounter.
changed_reading.after: The garden is a receiving station where a controlled descent comes into sheltered presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden imparting and repeated seeing surround a garden whose root carries concealment; later naming, desire, and conjecture are set against gentle guidance and reality. Concealment therefore marks a witnessed but non-manufactured referent, not an imagined object.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge imparted in hidden fashion establishes that concealment can transmit rather than negate reality.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies experiential verification before the concealed garden is named.
A name as designation supplies the contrasting mechanism of a label that can be made without a referent.
The soul's inclination supplies the pressure to project a desired destination.
Doubt and imagining identify the unstable epistemic mode contrasted with the focus encounter.
Gentle direction toward road and truth provides a non-projective route to the referent.
Stable correspondence with reality anchors the garden against mere naming and conjecture.
The focus garden's concealment now means hidden yet encountered reality rather than unreality.

structural_cues: Repeated seeing in 53:11-18 brackets the focus scene.
53:23-28 opposes manufactured names, desire, and conjecture to guidance, knowledge, and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden communication, verified seeing, concealment, and a later epistemic contrast; I infer that the contrast retroactively protects جنة from being read as wish-projection. The live alternative is that the polemic concerns only the named deities and does not qualify the garden.

changed_reading.before: The garden can be received as a familiar paradisal name or desired image.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a concealed but witnessed referent, distinguished from realities manufactured by naming, inclination, or conjecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the endpoint, the tree root activates an optical haze, an unspecified cover descends, and sight is praised for neither veering nor exceeding. activation_trace.role: The root's eye-veiling and visual-bewilderment image turns the named tree into a possible optical threshold.
The limit reached by a thing supplies the hard boundary at which perception must stop.

The eye's possible inclination or fatigue defines one failure mode that bounded perception avoids.
Literal eyesight makes visual calibration, not only abstract knowledge, part of the mechanism.
Exceeding a limit supplies the opposite failure mode of visual trespass.

structural_cues: 53:14 names the endpoint, 53:15 locates the garden there, 53:16 covers the tree, and 53:17-18 evaluates seeing.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint, eye-haze, covering, bounded sight, and visible signs; I infer that the cover filters or protects perception and that the garden names its sheltered side. A live alternative is that the covering conveys overwhelming majesty without any filtering function.

changed_reading.before: The garden is scenery visible at the farthest point.
changed_reading.after: The garden can be a protective perceptual enclosure at the limit, where signs are seen through disciplined non-trespassing vision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The soul inclines, follows, and pictures wishes, while guidance gently directs toward truth. Against those competing vectors, مأوى becomes a real gathering attractor reached by guided orientation rather than a destination fabricated by appetite.

activation_trace.role: Self-inclination supplies an inwardly generated vector that can pull away from the true refuge.

Gentle direction to road and truth supplies the counter-vector toward a valid destination.
A wish pictured by the heart supplies the false model of obtaining whatever destination one imagines.
Reality fixed against falsehood gives the guided vector an external terminus.
The sheltering gathering point acts as the destination that receives rather than mirrors desire.

structural_cues: 53:23 repeats restriction around following conjecture and desire, then closes with guidance.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two directional systems, inclination/following/wish and guidance/truth, plus a gathering refuge; I infer that they compete for the same human trajectory. The live alternative is that these verses regulate belief about the deities without describing movement toward the focus refuge.

changed_reading.before: The garden is the fulfillment of a desired destination.
changed_reading.after: The refuge is an external attractor that gathers a guided trajectory and resists being reduced to the soul's projected wish.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intercession joins one party to another only under permission, while burdens do not transfer and each purposeful movement receives complete recompense. The refuge consequently reads as personal convergence, not shelter one person can simply carry or procure for another.

activation_trace.role: An intercessor joining another supplies the social mechanism by which trajectories might otherwise be coupled.
Permission constrains that joining and prevents automatic transferred access.
The heavy load is explicitly nontransferable, individuating the traveler and what is carried.
The same root's refuge branch creates a live load-versus-shelter contrast within the personal-responsibility sequence.
Purposeful movement toward an aim gives each person an owned trajectory.
Matching action with its return ties arrival to what the traveler has enacted.
Completion without deficit closes the personal trajectory rather than leaving it socially fungible.
The focus shelter is the point of convergence whose access the sequence individualizes.

structural_cues: 53:26 qualifies intercession by permission; 53:38-41 then chains nontransferable burden, owned striving, visibility, and full recompense.
The first-person-independent nominal refuge in 53:15 remains available as destination while the later sequence specifies relations among travelers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constrained joining, nontransferable load, personal movement, and matched return; I infer that refuge cannot be socially transferred even though intercession may accompany a traveler by permission. A live alternative is that these rules govern accountability only and say nothing about entry into the garden.

changed_reading.before: Refuge is a generic collective shelter whose benefit might be borrowed through association.
changed_reading.after: Refuge becomes a personally convergent destination: accompaniment is possible, but burden, striving, and arrival are not simply transferable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root for garden recurs explicitly as fetuses hidden inside mothers, amid protective covering and origination; the later drop and other arising extend the sequence. This activates a womb-like refuge that shelters a transition into renewed life.

activation_trace.role: A cover that preserves what it hides supplies the gestational enclosure's protective layer.
Bringing a thing into being gives concealment a developmental direction.
The fetus hidden in the womb directly reactivates the focus garden root as covered nascent life.
The inside of a thing supplies the bounded interior in which hidden formation occurs.
Mother as bearer and nurturer supplies the enclosure's sustaining relation.
The generative drop supplies the small material beginning from which formation proceeds.
Renewed origination carries the womb mechanism beyond first formation toward another emergence.
Vigorous hidden growth gives the focus garden the material behavior of developing life.
Compassionate turning makes the developmental enclosure a refuge rather than mere confinement.

structural_cues: 53:32 places origination from earth beside the same ج ن ن root in the explicit fetal construction.
53:44-47 moves through death, life, paired creation, the generative drop, and another origination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root fetal concealment, maternal interior, preservation, a generative drop, and another origination; I supply the analogical arrow from womb to garden-refuge. The live alternative is that the shared root only explains concealment and does not make the garden a developmental interval.

changed_reading.before: The garden is final rest after life's process is complete.
changed_reading.after: The garden can coexist as a gestational refuge, a covered interval that tends life toward another emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Growth and increase are opposed by hard ground that stops digging and by vegetation stunted in drought; later remaining is explicitly denied to destroyed peoples. The focus garden's vigorous growth becomes persistence through blockage rather than decorative fertility.

Continuance and remaining supply the persistence that the destructive clause explicitly negates.
Thick, forceful growth makes the focus garden the material counterimage to stunting and stoppage.
Sheltering convergence provides the condition in which growth can continue rather than be cut off.

structural_cues: 53:34 couples giving a little with abrupt stoppage; its root inventory also carries hard substrate and stunted plants.
53:50-54 later intensifies interruption into destruction, no remainder, overturning, and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, blocked digging, stunted plants, denied persistence, and vigorous garden growth; I infer a material contrast in which refuge sustains continuation. changed_reading.before: The garden's vegetation is ornamental abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Falling into destruction, leaving no remainder, overturning orientation, and an all-covering event form a disintegration sequence. The focus garden's shield and gathering action become a counterspace in which integrity is preserved.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disintegration and two opposed kinds of covering; I infer that the earlier refuge is a preserved counterspace to the later collapse. strongest_changes: The static adjacent garden became a receiving sanctuary that resolves the surah's controlled descent and approach.
Concealment changed from absence into protected, verified presence, with bounded vision and signs resisting names, desire, and conjecture.
The repeated fetal root and another origination activated a coexisting womb-like, regenerative refuge rather than only final rest.
Personal burden and striving, later destruction, and non-uncoverability made refuge nontransferable, preserving, and near without being self-opened.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots produced an unusually dense mechanism: proximity holds together concealment or growth and sheltering convergence. Context then activated kinetic, optical, epistemic, gestational, legal-social, ecological, destructive, and bodily readings without forcing them into one resolution.
remaining_uncertainties: The garden may receive the descent, filter perception, or simply stand adjacent to both; the packet does not force one directional arrow.
The womb, catchment, hard-ground, burden-refuge, and tomb-womb models depend on branch analogies that should remain explicitly exploratory.
Near concealment may indicate protection, overwhelming majesty, sovereign access control, or several of these at once.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A sheltered garden adjoining the boundary.** ع ن د B004 supplies presence beside; ج ن ن B003 supplies a tree-covered garden; ء و ي B001 supplies a sheltering or gathering point. Spatial adjacency to 53:14 makes the endpoint also a refuge. I infer that finality need not be exposed emptiness; the ayah reads as terminal boundary joined to protected habitation.
2. **Layered concealment as refuge.** ج ن ن B001 supplies covering and concealment, while ء و ي B001 supplies drawing into shelter. The next ayah's covering repeats the same material logic. I infer that concealment here protects and gathers rather than obscures falsely; *jannat al-maʾwā* reads as an architecture of cover.
3. **Compassionate resort.** ء و ي B002 supplies compassionate turning in pity. Because the basmalah frames the surah with ر ح م B001 and 53:32 later names expansive forgiveness, I infer that shelter is an enacted form of mercy. The ayah reads affectively as received refuge as well as spatial destination.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:32's hidden fetus in the mother's interior activates ج ن ن B007 and ب ط ن B001 as another protective concealment. That later biological shelter makes the garden-refuge read as part of a repeated architecture of covered formation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Concealment functioning as shelter rather than deception.** `ع ن د B004` supplies presence, `ج ن ن B001` covering and concealment, `ج ن ن B003` a tree-covered garden, and `ء و ي B001` drawing into a sheltering or gathering point. The adjacent endpoint and the following covering event create a layered enclosure, while 53:17-18 confirms that the enclosure does not falsify sight. The packet supplies concealment, shelter, cover, and verified perception; I infer the arrow regulated enclosure -> protected reception. The fixed ayah reads as a sheltering zone at the boundary, not merely a destination named after concealment.

2. **A compassionate gathering beside the limit.** `ء و ي B002` supplies compassionate turning toward someone in pity. The servant-reception relation in 53:10 and the difficult visual threshold in 53:14-17 activate this accepted variant. The packet supplies servanthood, limit, and refuge; I infer the arrow vulnerability at a limit -> compassionate gathering. The `مأوى` can therefore read as relational care as well as spatial shelter.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:16-18 clarified that concealment here can protect rather than deceive: the enclosure covers the threshold without preventing reliable sight of signs.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aklın örtülmesini, benlik ile akıl arasına engel girmesini, kişinin bu duruma düşmesini veya düşürülmesini bildirir; görünüşte bu hali takınma da ayrı bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek ya da gösterilen akıl yitimiyle sınırlıdır; görünmeyen varlıklar ve ağaçlı bahçe anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın akıl yitimi dalını kapsar ve başka dalların varlık ya da yer anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Aklın işleyişini örten veya benlik ile akıl arasına engel koyan akıl yitimi durumudur; kişi bu duruma düşebilir, düşürülebilir ya da böyleymiş gibi davranabilir.

facets.statement: Akıl yitimi, aklın örtülmesi veya benlik ile akıl arasına engel girmesi olarak kavranır.
Kişinin aklını yitirmesi ile bir etkenin onu bu duruma getirmesi katılımcıları farklı iki süreçtir.
Gerçek durumdan ayrı olarak kişi kendisini aklını yitirmiş gibi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar akıl işleyişinin örtülmesi ve kişinin aklını yitirmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir; ettirgen süreç ile görünüşte bu hali takınmayı da kaydeder.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl yitimini ve bunun aklı örten bir engel olarak kavranmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin gerçek bir akıl yitimi durumuna girdiği geçişsiz kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin akıl işleyişini kaybetmesini ve durum değişimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin gerçek durumu değil, bu durumun görünüşünü isteyerek sergilediği bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl yitimini gerçek yaşamadan onun görünüşünü sergileme ayrımını korur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar rahimde veya anne karnında bulunan doğmamış çocuk tanımında birleşir; taşıma ve rahimde saklı kalma süreçlerini de kaydeder.

Kuşların toplanması, yaranın iyileşmeye yaklaşması ve atları sese döndürme kullanımı bu çekirdeğin özel veya ilişkili görünümleridir; duygusal acıma anlamı bu dala ait değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyin barınacağı, toplanacağı ya da döneceği bir yere yönelip katılması; ayrıca başkasını böyle bir yere alıp barındırmasıdır. Kuşların bir araya gelmesi, yaranın iyileşmeye yaklaşması ve atları sese döndürme kullanımları bu katılma ve toparlanma çizgisinin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlık, kendisini toplayan veya barındıran bir yere yönelip oraya katılır.
Başkasını bir yere alıp yerleştirme ve barındırma aynı çekirdeğin ettirgen görünümüdür.
Barınılan veya dönülen yer, gece ya da gündüz başvurulan yer olarak adlandırılır.
Kuşların birbirine katılıp toplanması ve yaranın kapanmaya yaklaşması, birleşme çizgisindeki özel kullanımlardır.
Atları belli bir sesle geri döndürmeye çağırma kullanımı, sese yönelip dönme ilişkisiyle bağlıdır.
